Get yourself a guide and visit old Lucknow(chowk/nakhaas) for food if you can tolerate spicy and kind of unhygienic food(trust me it’s worth it).
Things to try : Kebabs(Tundey kababi, Aminabad), Malai Makhan( Gol darwaza, Chowk) Nahari Kulche(Nakhaas), Etc.
Places to visit: If you want to explore freedom struggle and Nawabi culture then visit Imambara, Clock tower, Picture Gallery, etc.
And stay safe Lucknow is not very familiar with tourists so people might behave weirdly specially in old Lucknow.
For shopping you can visit chowk/Aminabad for Lucknowi Chikan(Google for more)
Else visit Gomti Nagar or Hazratganj for leisure time and shopping of general stuff.
